fade.retest_tol_pct.rule: B2.3 retest tolerance on the proxy, %

fade.lock_trigger_r.rule: B2.5 close at this R arms the lock

fade.lock_level_r.rule: B2.5 stop moves to this R once armed

fade.cut_r.rule: B2.5 early cut: 3rd bar close at or below this R

fade.target_r.rule: B2.5 R multiple of the take-profit (was fixed 2R)

fade.take_frac.rule: B2.5/B5.2 share sold at the take-profit (was fixed 1/3, floor of shares)

fade.chandelier_atr.rule: B2.5/B5.4 chandelier ATR multiple for the runner (was fixed 2)

pb.stop_buffer_pct.rule: B3.7 stop buffer below the dip low, %

risk.pct.rule: B4.1 account risk per trade, as a % of total account value (never dollars). Downward only, only with --risk-off. Raising it above 3.0 needs the governor to edit hi

size.cap_pct.rule: B4.1 largest position as a % of total account value (never dollars). Downward only, only with --risk-off. Adds a third term to B4.1: floor(cap% x total_value / ask). It binds only below 100

goals.note: Governor goals. Objective: 0.4% per trading day averaged over a year. The 15% limit matches A1.13. Used by the menu gate, the proposer prompt and status.
